summary: R1 producer masking is repaired, but the independent oracle does not reject a hash-consistent valid label containing raw unresolved safety receipts. R2 logical split/cooperate discovery source path is provisionally repaired; focused evidence lacks split and exactly-once/oracle coverage. R3 primary raw evidence was not supplied and remains open.
hash_scope: Changed source and directly referenced helper/test inputs read for the R1/R2 impact review; not a release freeze. Initial 27-item manifest remains preserved in V33_SOURCE_AUDIT.json.

issues.title: Independent oracle accepts raw unresolved safety on a coherently marked valid label
issues.details: Runner and collector now mask unresolved safety and retain receipts. The oracle checks unresolved summaries for already-invalid pairs, but its valid path only compares the summary and continues into cost/gain recomputation. A hash-consistent label/pair/trace marked valid can therefore carry an unresolved receipt without being rejected.
issues.required_closure: Reject any raw-derived unresolved reason before valid cost/gain return; test forged/hash-consistent valid flags, live-receipt-only unresolved evidence, and shard count exclusion.

issues.title: Logical discovery source path repaired, but split and evidence closure are missing
issues.details: Logical completion requires all physical children and schedules the dependent rescue once with parent identity and report delay. The contract test covers cooperative partial/full completion and delay, but has no split case, no exact-once assertions after repeated steps, and no paired label/oracle gain recomputation tied to the revealed rescue.
issues.required_closure: Add split and cooperate exact-once generation/receipt tests, repeated-step no-resend checks, and independent paired oracle recomputation with the dependent rescue in the obligation set.

issues.title: Primary raw pair evidence not supplied
issues.details: The requested production raw paired labels/traces and local binding path were not available for this follow-up. The initial focused artifact remains invalid and non-replayable.
issues.required_closure: Provide the raw keep/replan traces, label, oracle receipt, local resolvable path, and hashes; preserve the prior failed artifact.

R1_producer_masking.details: Updated runner, collector, label aggregation, and shard validity path propagate unresolved safety as unknown/masked and retain raw evidence.

R1_independent_oracle.details: Valid-path oracle recomputation does not reject nonempty raw-derived unresolved safety reasons.

R2_logical_discovery_source.details: All-child logical completion, delayed parent-identity report, deduplication and raw event capture are connected in the updated source.

R2_test_evidence.details: Only cooperative completion is covered; split, exact-once after repeated steps, and gain/oracle closure are absent.

R3_primary_evidence.details: Awaiting production raw evidence path from coordinator.

rereview_scope: R2 logical split/cooperate discovery source and tests
R3 primary raw pair evidence pending
